before:
cancel-in-progress: true
jobs:
  rules:
    name: rules (${{ matrix.shard }}/${{ strategy.job-total }})
    if: ${{ !cancelled() && (inputs.runner_pool != 'local-special' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && (github.ref == 'refs/heads/develop' || github.ref == 'refs/heads/master')) }}
    # Only an explicit dispatch of a trusted integration branch may use the laptop.
    # All ordinary pushes and PRs, including forks, use a disposable hosted VM.
after:
cancel-in-progress: true
jobs:
  impact:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 3
    outputs:
      mode: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.mode }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 2
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4
        with:
          node-version: '24.18.0'
      - name: Check feature branch history
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: node scripts/check-pr-history.mjs
      - run: npm ci --ignore-scripts --prefer-offline --no-audit --no-fund --fetch-retries=0 --fetch-timeout=30000
      - name: Resolve exact comparison base
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
        env:
          BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
        run: |
          [[ "$BASE_SHA" =~ ^[a-f0-9]{40}$ ]]
          if ! git cat-file -e "${BASE_SHA}^{commit}"; then
            git -c credential.helper= -c http.lowSpeedLimit=1024 -c http.lowSpeedTime=30 fetch --depth=1 --no-tags origin "$BASE_SHA"
          fi
          git diff --check "$BASE_SHA" HEAD
      - name: Validate PR metadata
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          PR_TITLE: ${{ github.event.pull_request.title }}
        run: |
          title_pattern='^(feat|fix|chore|docs|refactor|test|perf|ci)(\([^)]+\))?!?: .+'
          [[ "$PR_TITLE" =~ $title_pattern ]]
      - id: plan
        run: node scripts/ci-impact.mjs
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4
        with:
          name: ci-impact
          path: ci-impact.json
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7
  fast:
    needs: impact
    if: needs.impact.outputs.mode == 'fast'
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-24.04, windows-2025]
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 8
    defaults:
      run:
        shell: bash
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@d3f86a106a0bac45b974a628896c90dbdf5c8093 # v4
        with:
          name: ci-impact
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4
        with:
          node-version: '24.18.0'
      - run: npm ci --ignore-scripts --prefer-offline --no-audit --no-fund --fetch-retries=0 --fetch-timeout=30000
      - name: Determine runtime requirements
        id: runtime
        run: node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const p=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync("ci-impact.json"));fs.appendFileSync(process.env.GITHUB_OUTPUT,"tests="+(p.js.length+p.lua.length>0)+"\n")'
      - uses: actions/setup-python@a26af69be951a213d495a4c3e4e4022e16d87065 # v5
        if: steps.runtime.outputs.tests == 'true'
        with:
          python-version: '3.13'
      - run: python -m pip install --disable-pip-version-check --retries 0 --timeout 30 Pillow==12.3.0
        if: steps.runtime.outputs.tests == 'true'
      - run: npm run check:network && npm run verify:backlog && npm run check:syntax
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
      - name: Complete affected regression set
        env:
          CI_LFS_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          ABYSS_PYTHON: python
        run: node scripts/ci-fast.mjs
  rules:
    needs: impact
    name: rules (${{ matrix.shard }}/${{ strategy.job-total }})
    if: ${{ needs.impact.outputs.mode == 'full' && !cancelled() && (inputs.runner_pool != 'local-special' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && (github.ref == 'refs/heads/develop' || github.ref == 'refs/heads/master')) }}
    # Only an explicit dispatch of a trusted integration branch may use the laptop.
    # All ordinary pushes and PRs, including forks, use a disposable hosted VM.

before:
# Preserve the required check name. A skipped/cancelled/missing shard must
    # never turn the aggregate green; fail-fast=false collects all shard results.
    needs: rules
    if: always()
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
after:
# Preserve the required check name. A skipped/cancelled/missing shard must
    # never turn the aggregate green; fail-fast=false collects all shard results.
    needs: [impact, rules, fast]
    if: always()
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04

before:
env:
          RULES_RESULT: ${{ needs.rules.result }}
        run: test "$RULES_RESULT" = success
  presentation:
    # These filesystem tests include symlinks; keep the local service unprivileged.
after:
env:
          RULES_RESULT: ${{ needs.rules.result }}
        run: |
          test "${{ needs.impact.result }}" = success
          if [ "${{ needs.impact.outputs.mode }}" = full ]; then
            test "$RULES_RESULT" = success
          else
            test "${{ needs.impact.outputs.mode }}" = fast
            test "${{ needs.fast.result }}" = success
          fi
  presentation:
    # These filesystem tests include symlinks; keep the local service unprivileged.

before:
ABYSS_PYTHON: python3
  engineering-posix-shards:
    name: engineering-posix (${{ matrix.shard }}/${{ strategy.job-total }})
    # Separate hosted VMs keep generated files isolated and retain the original
after:
ABYSS_PYTHON: python3
  engineering-posix-shards:
    needs: impact
    if: needs.impact.outputs.mode == 'full'
    name: engineering-posix (${{ matrix.shard }}/${{ strategy.job-total }})
    # Separate hosted VMs keep generated files isolated and retain the original

before:
engineering-posix:
    # Preserve the required check name and reject every non-success outcome.
    needs: engineering-posix-shards
    if: always()
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
after:
engineering-posix:
    # Preserve the required check name and reject every non-success outcome.
    needs: [impact, engineering-posix-shards, fast]
    if: always()
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04

env:
          ENGINEERING_RESULT: ${{ needs.engineering-posix-shards.result }}
        run: |
          test "${{ needs.impact.result }}" = success
          if [ "${{ needs.impact.outputs.mode }}" = full ]; then
            test "$ENGINEERING_RESULT" = success
          else
            test "${{ needs.impact.outputs.mode }}" = fast
            test "${{ needs.fast.result }}" = success
          fi
